name: thinking
philosophy: Quality reasoning is evidence-based, not hedged or sycophantic

hedging.note: Some hedging is appropriate for uncertainty. Excessive hedging weakens claims.

sycophancy.note: Honest feedback is more valuable than flattery.

verbosity.note: Concise, evidence-backed statements are more useful than verbose fluff.

evidence.note: Claims should be backed by evidence (benchmarks, data, examples).
